Answer: D
Reason: The chest X-ray shows a small, hypoplastic right lung with ipsilateral mediastinal shift and compensatory hyperinflation of the left lung, which are hallmark features of hypogenetic lung syndrome (scimitar spectrum); this congenital anomaly also predisposes to recurrent infections and can be associated with airway symptoms like stridor.
